interpretation: Fresh native devices with the same CPU frustum set. Both controls add one equal-size queue write per camera list; only ascending versus fixed-seed shuffled instance order changes. Actual GPU storage indices must match the intervention, and their sorted set must be identical. Reflection lists, source matrices/materials, shaders, camera and physical state are unchanged. Every HDR/normal/specular/current/velocity/depth/TAA channel is compared exactly against ascending references; same-order repeat SHA256 is checked independently. Additional dispatches/readbacks/waits are correctness observations, not performance measurements. Divergence demonstrates order-dependent rendering in this workload; it does not alone identify a shader/driver cause.
